t: This is The Throne of Earthly Kings, a sculpture by the French artist François Hameury. Hameury made the piece, and his name is the one to remember here. The title suggests a seat of power, so look at how the work plays with that idea of a throne. I don't have further details about its materials, its date, or how it came to be here, so take your time with it and decide what the title says to you.
